resources.string: Lets Calo learn a flow from one voice+tap demo and replay it later on your command. Never acts on password, OTP, or payment screens.
Tap the marble and say what you want, or teach Calo something new.
Calo needs microphone access to hear voice commands.
Teaching — demonstrate the flow, then tap Finish Teaching.
Calo\'s accessibility service isn\'t on — enable it in Settings → Accessibility → Calo.
What will you say to trigger it? e.g. \"order my usual pizza\"
Both fields are required to save the flow.
Saved. Try the phrase you just taught.
Nothing was captured — demonstrate at least one tap before finishing.
Didn\'t catch that tap — only incidental screen activity was recorded. Try again.
Leave a step blank to always repeat the exact same value. Name it (e.g. \"item\", \"quantity\") to let voice commands fill in something different each time.
Slot name — leave blank to keep this value fixed
